name: Meadowbell
blurb: A low cream bell. Pollinators treat a stand of them as an invitation.

name: Peach
blurb: A dwarf peach with one heavy fruit. The stall keeps a tray for these.

name: Reed
blurb: Tall water grass. Bulrush will not wade in without a stand of it.

name: Bramble
blurb: A low cane with dark fruit. It thickens the hedges and feeds Berrypatch.

name: Mosspear
blurb: A ground pear that only sweetens in rich soil.

name: Nightlantern
blurb: A dusk bulb. It will only take in soil that Dusknip has changed.
